children: ACV Auctions announced a definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger with Copart, under which Copart will commence a cash tender offer to acquire all ACV shares at $10.50 per share, followed by a back-end merger under Section 251(h). The offer is subject to a majority tender condition, HSR clearance, and other customary conditions, and is not contingent on financing. Equity awards will be cashed out or converted into Copart awards as specified. In parallel, certain ACV stockholders holding about 4.1% of shares signed a Support Agreement to tender and vote for the deal, enhancing closing certainty. The merger agreement includes termination fees of $57.7 million payable by ACV in certain circumstances and $115.3 million payable by Copart under specified regulatory-related outcomes.
